alternatives.note: Adds an AQI 1-5 index; similar TVOC/eCO2 estimates.

description: Air quality: TVOC (ppb) and equivalent CO2 (ppm), with humidity compensation and baseline save/restore

baseline_eco2.description: Current eCO2 baseline, to save to storage.

baseline_tvoc.description: Current TVOC baseline, to save to storage.

ready.description: False during the 15 s warm-up after init, or if the last read failed.

set_baseline.description: Restore baselines saved earlier (call in setup, after a fresh boot).

set_humidity.description: Humidity compensation from air temperature (°C) and relative humidity (%), e.g. from an SHT31 or BME280. Call whenever they change.

tvoc.description: Total volatile organic compounds in ppb (0-60000).

name: SGP30
tips: Read it once per second: the baseline algorithm depends on a steady 1 Hz rate. The driver measures at most once per second however often you call it.
For the first 15 s after power-up it reports 400 ppm eCO2 and 0 ppb TVOC (warming up); ready() is false until then.
Save baseline_eco2()/baseline_tvoc() to storage about once an hour and restore them with set_baseline() at boot; a stored baseline older than 7 days should be discarded.
eCO2 is estimated from hydrogen, not measured; use an SCD4x for true CO2.
